name: re8ch-cluster-infra-tool
description: Operate RE8CH Cilium, Ceph, Pigsty, Harbor, Grafana, LiteLLM and GitHub infrastructure.

interface.shortDescription: Observe and operate RE8CH cluster infrastructure and storage.
interface.longDescription: Domain operations for networking, Rook/Ceph, Ready-node filesystem and swap capacity, databases, artifacts, observability and monorepo deployment evidence. Authentication is shared once at the RE8CH MCP edge; authorization remains enforced by server policy and cluster RBAC.
defaultPrompt: Execute this authorized infrastructure operation and verify rollback status.
